local_vs_store: Store and local use a single join, the same output partition, the pinned two-row paired inner loop in both matrices, and compute SwiGLU at the same site from the calculated Up scalars. Store additionally saves both rows of Up to the preexisting workspace: 65,536 bytes of logical store traffic on this fixture. Both reserve the same allocation. The two comparison modes scan the input twice, just like reference. The reference pipeline also uses a separate activation pass, so its ratio is an aggregate, not a pure writeback effect.
down: Identical calls across labels. Use a single frozen slice produced by the reference path, and measure it separately with no preceding timed Gate/Up for that arm.

gate.advance: Require exactness, same-path and Down controls, and both local/store and local/reference to pass independently in each of the two blocks for both worker counts. Only then advance to production-shaped live model timing before proposing adoption.
